query: can i cancel my order i just placed
reference_answer: Yes, free within 2 hours of ordering from My Orders. After that it's in the packing queue and support can try to intercept but it's not guaranteed.

query: ordered 3 hrs ago can i still change it
reference_answer: Not online; after 2 hours it's in the packing queue. Support can try to intercept before shipping but it's not guaranteed.

query: cant change address its shipped already
reference_answer: Sorry, the shipping address can't be changed after shipping, and couriers don't accept redirection requests from Leafy.

query: how old do i need to be for an account
reference_answer: You must be 18 or older to hold an account.

query: do u print prices on gift slips
reference_answer: No, prices are never printed on gift packing slips. Gift orders get a free printed gift note up to 200 characters.

query: gift note max length?
reference_answer: Up to 200 characters, free on gift orders.

query: does the plant come with a decorative pot
reference_answer: Plants ship in plastic nursery pots with drainage holes. Decorative pots are sold separately unless the listing says 'potted'.

query: item i ordered is out of stock what now
reference_answer: We email within 24 hours offering a similar plant of equal or higher value, a wait of up to 14 days, or a refund for that item. No reply within 3 days means an automatic refund.

query: can i return a plant i dont like it anymore
reference_answer: No, live plants can't be returned for change of mind. Plant problems go through the Plant Care Guarantee or Damaged on Arrival.

query: return window for pots
reference_answer: 30 days from delivery, unused and in original packaging.

query: my return label expired
reference_answer: Labels expire after 7 days. The KB doesn't say how to get a new one, so I'd offer to escalate/check with the team.

query: opened bag of soil can i send back
reference_answer: Not unless it's faulty; opened soil or fertiliser can't be returned otherwise.

query: how much is return shipping if i change my mind
reference_answer: A flat $6.95 deducted from the refund, free for Leafy Plus members.

query: can i exchange a pot for a different size
reference_answer: No direct exchanges: return the item and place a new order.

query: how long for refund after u get my return
reference_answer: Within 5 business days of the return reaching our warehouse, to the original payment method.

query: shipping cost?
reference_answer: Standard is $7.95 (free on $75+ after discounts, before tax); Express is $14.95.

query: is express free with leafy plus
reference_answer: No, Express is never free, including for Leafy Plus.

query: what days do plants ship
reference_answer: Live plants ship Monday–Wednesday only.

query: ordered plant thursday when will it ship
reference_answer: Plant orders placed after 12 noon Wednesday ship the next Monday.

query: extra fee for big plants?
reference_answer: XL plants (usually over 4 ft) add a $20 handling fee and ship Standard only.

query: express to zone 3 pls
reference_answer: Express isn't available in Zone 3 (over 1,000 miles, remote and island addresses); Standard takes 5–8 business days.

query: can u ship to canada
reference_answer: No, Leafy doesn't offer international shipping.

query: can plants go to a po box
reference_answer: No, PO boxes are for non-living items only.

query: tracking hasnt moved in 5 days
reference_answer: Contact support; if tracking hasn't moved for 4 business days we open a courier investigation (up to 5 business days). If lost, you choose a free replacement or full refund.

query: it says delivered but nothing here
reference_answer: Contact support; we open a courier investigation of up to 5 business days. If lost, choose a free replacement or full refund.

query: why is my plant order on hold its freezing
reference_answer: If transit forecasts are below 35°F or above 95°F, plants may be held up to 7 days and you're emailed. You can waive the hold by replying, but then cold/heat damage isn't covered.

query: how long is the plant guarantee
reference_answer: 30 days from delivery, or 90 days for Leafy Plus members on plants ordered while the membership is active.

query: 2 leaves went yellow is that covered
reference_answer: Yellowing of one or two older leaves in the first two weeks is normal transplant stress and not covered on its own.

query: how many photos for a claim
reference_answer: At least two photos: whole plant and close-up, submitted from My Orders. A specialist reviews within 2 business days.

query: do i have to send the dead plant back
reference_answer: No, the plant does not need to be sent back.

query: my replacement plant died too
reference_answer: A replacement has its own new 30-day guarantee, so it can be replaced once more. The plant sent as that second replacement has no guarantee.

query: i repotted day 5 in my own soil and it died covered?
reference_answer: No, repotting into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days isn't covered.

query: box arrived stem snapped in half
reference_answer: Sorry! Report within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the plant and box. You get a free replacement on the next plant shipping day or a refund.

query: got my order 3 days ago pot was cracked, too late?
reference_answer: DOA reports must be within 48 hours of delivery. For plants, after that it goes through the Plant Care Guarantee; for a non-living item the KB doesn't give a later option, so I'd offer to escalate.

query: you sent the wrong plant
reference_answer: Sorry about that. We ship the correct item free by Express (where zone allows) with a free return label, and a wrong live plant can be kept at no charge.

query: few bent leaves on arrival is that damage
reference_answer: No, a few bent leaves or loose soil is normal and not damage.

query: charged twice for one order
reference_answer: First check whether one is a pending authorisation. If both posted, send the order number and last four card digits; the duplicate is refunded within 3 business days of confirmation. Never share the full card number, security code or password.

query: can i pay with bank transfer
reference_answer: No. Accepted: credit/debit cards, digital wallets, and Leafy gift cards. No cash, cheques or bank transfers.

query: buy now pay later limits
reference_answer: Available on orders of $50–$1,000.

query: cancelled order but money still pending
reference_answer: A pending authorisation drops off in 3–7 business days depending on the bank; Leafy can't release it faster.

query: my old card was closed can refund go to new card
reference_answer: Refunds go only to the original payment method, never a different card. The bank normally passes it to the replacement card. Alternatively you can take instant Leafy store credit.

query: price dropped 3 days after i bought can i get the diff
reference_answer: Yes, within 7 days the difference is given as store credit, once per item, excluding flash sales and clearance.

query: can i use 2 promo codes
reference_answer: No, one promo code per order, and it can't be added after ordering.

query: lost my gift card code
reference_answer: Lost codes are reissued if the purchaser gives the gift card order number.

query: when does plant club charge me
reference_answer: On the 25th of the previous month; boxes ship in the first full week of the month.

query: cancel plant club on the 26th will i still get next box
reference_answer: Changes on or after the 25th apply to the following month's box, so the already-billed box is not refunded and is still sent. No cancellation fee.

query: leafy plus refund? bought it 10 days ago havent used anything
reference_answer: Yes, full refund if cancelled within 14 days of purchase or renewal and no benefits have been used.

query: do you have a phone number
reference_answer: No phone support. Chat is 8am–8pm Mon–Sat, email help@leafy.example is answered within 1 business day.

query: my dog ate some of my pothos what do i do
reference_answer: Contact your vet or local poison control immediately. Pothos isn't pet-safe. Then we'll escalate to a human Support Lead.
